summary: Both phases are planned with a targeted Red command, a Green gate, and a closeout gate per plan task. Phase 1 is risk high, because the money rule of D-3 is two truncation steps over a BigInt product and a float slip is silent. Phase 2 is risk medium, because its code is a manifest entry and a section, and its highest-severity risk (a used screen shows the development class name) is human-gated by D-14. The strategy pins the six rates as strings from (rate * 100).toFixed(4), the three presets to the satang, the two conservation equalities in integer satang, and a 1e9-volume satang pin that separates the BigInt path (71,422,027,600) from the float path (71,422,027,583). Review B does not apply as a separate role: the surface is a static public page with client-side arithmetic, no auth, no persistence, and no server input; six security probes fold into Review A. Review C applies to both phases. Four questions go to the PM, and the manifest shape carries a default.

phases.name: The commission calculator
phases.risk_reason: Money determinism under D-3, the conservation identity, and the zero floor are silent-failure surfaces; the calculator renders on a live public page after the single Phase 2 push.
phases.red_command: pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage exec vitest run src/lib/tutor-commission.test.ts src/__tests__/www-tutor-calculator.locale.test.ts src/components/marketing/tutor-commission-calculator.test.tsx "src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/products/tutor-advantage/page.test.tsx" --silent=true
phases.green_gate: Each task's targeted vitest command exits 0, and the inherited src/__tests__/products-page-pictures.red.test.tsx exits 0.
phases.closeout_gate: pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage test --reporter=dot --silent=true; pnpm turbo run check-types --filter=www-reading-advantage; pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage lint; git diff --exit-code scripts/ci/shadcn-ratchet-baseline.json; pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage build (all through heavy-run.sh)

phases.name: The screens gallery and the live copy
phases.risk_reason: Code risk is a manifest entry, a section, and two strings. The high-severity part (a screen shows the development class name) has no automated falsifier by D-14 and is carried by the per-file blur review and the PM page-check. The two changed live lines are the public-claim risk.
phases.red_command: pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage exec vitest run src/lib/__tests__/tutor-screens.test.ts src/__tests__/www-tutor-calculator.locale.test.ts "src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/products/tutor-advantage/page.test.tsx" --silent=true
phases.green_gate: The same targeted set exits 0, and the inherited picture test exits 0 over the three new manifest values.
phases.closeout_gate: The five Phase 1 gates again, then node scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs --base ff028a7105ccd5de0c3e9534dd8536b7667e22de --head <full HEAD> must print ["www-reading-advantage"].

gates.install_pre_gate: bash /home/daniebo/Desktop/advantage-pr/scripts/jobs/heavy-run.sh -c 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile', then git diff --exit-code pnpm-lock.yaml. The worktree has no node_modules, so the first filtered vitest exits EACCES without this step.
gates.selector: node scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs --base ff028a7105ccd5de0c3e9534dd8536b7667e22de --head <40-character HEAD>. The script exits 2 unless both ids are 40 characters; a 9-character base and a measure-only range do not produce evidence.
gates.aggregate_suite: pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage test runs legacy .red.test.ts files that are green at the base. The track adds no always-red file, so the gate must exit 0. A baseline run at phase_base_sha records test_files and tests as labeled integers and the failing file names.
gates.no_deploy: No deploy command and no Cloud Run change. One www-only push after the PM page-check, standing approval read per D-13 and open question 5.

money_facts_measured.pinning_method: (commissionRate(V) * 100).toFixed(4) compared as a string; never toBeCloseTo.

review_a.reason: P1 carries the money algorithm, the BigInt truncation, and the copy fidelity; P2 carries the manifest shape, the asset paths, the DOM order, and the absence of the old live lines.

review_b.reason: Static public page, client-side arithmetic over local state, no auth, no session, no persistence, no server input, no new dependency, no external fetch. Probes: no network call, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no dependency or lockfile change, the only inline style is a numeric CSS custom property, the push is one app, nothing is stored.

review_c.reason: New public contract: calculator.* and screens.* key paths, the tutorScreens export, the two data-testids, the DOM order, the accessibility states, and the two live lines.

architecture_guardrails: productPictures is as const satisfies Record<string, ProductPictureFile>, and products-page-pictures.red.test.tsx:59 stats every value, so the tutor screens are a sibling export, not a nested entry.
The calculator is a client component with server props (D-12): no next-intl or @/locales import inside it, asserted over the source file.
One inline style, a CSS custom property for the run-time bar width, is the only style the component may hold.
The commitments section has no testid today; task 1.7 adds data-testid="tutor-commitments" as the order anchor.
No new dependency and no pnpm-lock.yaml change; the shadcn ratchet stays at lintWarnings 241 and copies 36.
residual_risks: A later translator edit breaks the zh-equals-en identity; only a later test run catches it.
The shared CD pipeline can fail for reasons outside this range.
520 px phone sources are upscaled at 1280 px; no test asserts sharpness.
The decorative rate curve's shape is not asserted; only the text figures are.
The module is not compared to finance-mlm-service; the pins come from the spec.
The no-JavaScript state is not asserted.
